cancellation: terminate child, remove temporary summary and authority outputs; prior complete summary remains atomic
compensation: delete non-authorizing summary; no runtime authority changes

injection.failure: oversized/child-failure atomic summary fixtures and SIGTERM cleanup tests

mechanism: bounded sanitized JSON to sibling, fsync, atomic replace last
next: real shadow measures non-authorizing parity; strict remains receipt gate
rerun: owned work is preflighted then rebuilt; final summary stays complete

sentinel.result: atomic failure fixtures preserve or replace only with complete JSON
